subject: Evidence ingest and signed manifest for admin activity export
messages:
From: Tara Venkataraman <audit@medicosys.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: compliance@medicosys.com
Date: 2026-09-03T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evidence ingest and signed manifest for admin activity export

Hi Hannah,

As part of MedicaSys's SOC 2 readiness check we need a copy of Redwood's admin activity logs (admin actions, operator/admin API events, role changes, privileged session starts/stops) covering the fiscal 2025 window: 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31.

Specifically we need:
- A machine-readable export (CSV/NDJSON) or S3-deliverable bundle containing the raw event files
- A signed manifest containing filename, file size, sha256 checksum, and a signed timestamp
- Documentation of what fields are included and any PII redaction rules applied
- Retention/TTL and canonical timezone used for timestamps
- Chain-of-custody for when files were generated and transferred

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
1) Produce a bulk export (full snapshot) plus an incremental delta for the same range?
2) Provide an HMAC/sha256-signed manifest we can verify after download?
3) Redact user email addresses to a stable hash (we can provide a salt if required)?
4) Deliver via a pre-provisioned S3 bucket with customer-side KMS, or alternatively an encrypted tar delivered over an encrypted transfer?

Our audit window is tight; we'd like to receive the export and manifest by Sept 10 if feasible. If you can include an estimated ETA and the export footprint (GBs), that would help our logistics.

Thanks,
Tara Venkataraman
Audit Lead, MedicaSys Health
Tel: +1 617-555-0124

Hi Tara — thanks for the clear checklist. We can support the workflow you've described. High-level plan and answers below.

1) Export types and cadence
- We can produce a full snapshot (NDJSON compressed) for the requested range plus an incremental delta set broken out by day. Full snapshot generation typically takes 12–36 hours depending on size; incremental deltas are generated in 1–2 hours.

2) Manifest and signing
- We will produce a CSV manifest with these columns: filename, relative_path, file_size_bytes, sha256_hex, generated_at_utc, file_range_start, file_range_end.
- Manifest will be signed using Redwood's key and we'll provide a detached signature (rsa-sha256) plus optional HMAC per-file using a customer-supplied salt if you prefer. Sample manifest attached.

3) PII redaction and hashing
- By default we redact user email addresses to a stable salted sha256 hash (salt stored in our key vault). If you require a customer-provided salt for cross-validation, we can accept that as part of the handshake.
- Redaction policy: replace user_email and token fields with hash; session_id and request_id are retained as-is for event linkage.

4) Delivery options and chain-of-custody
- Preferred: deliver to a customer-provisioned S3 bucket (s3://redwood-audit-uploads/medicosys/) with customer-side KMS CMK. We will upload via multipart with server-side encryption disabled (you control the key).
- Alternate: AES-256 encrypted .tar.gz with detached signature delivered over an encrypted transfer link.
- For chain-of-custody we provide a signed transfer manifest with upload timestamps and multipart ETAGs; we also provide a delivery log containing uploader identity, job_id, and hashes.

Fields we log (admin activity event schema):
- timestamp_utc (ISO 8601)
- actor_id (internal user id)
- actor_email_hash (sha256)
- actor_role
- action (create/update/delete/grant/revoke/login/assume_role)
- resource_type
- resource_id
- ip_address_v4
- session_id
- request_id
- request_payload_id (pointer to stored payload blob)
- outcome (success/failure)
- before_value (nullable, redacted)
- after_value (nullable, redacted)

Retention and timezone
- Exported events will use UTC timestamps.
- Redwood retains admin activity logs for 36 months in our live index, and we can produce export artifacts for any historic window within that retention. For SOC 2 evidence we recommend we snapshot and keep the delivered bundle for an additional 12 months as part of the attestation package (we can mark it in our retention ledger).

ETA and footprint
- Estimated export footprint for 2025 window: ~18–26 GB (NDJSON compressed) depending on payload retention level.
- ETA to produce snapshot + manifest: 48 hours after confirmation of delivery method and KMS details.

Next steps
- Confirm preferred delivery: [customer-owned S3 with CMK] or [encrypted tar delivery]
- If S3: provide destination bucket ARN and KMS CMK id and a pre-authorized role or temporary creds.
- If you want customer-supplied salt for hashing, provide it now.

I attached an admin-activity-spec README and a sample signed-manifest CSV to this reply.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Trust & Safety Operations
Redwood Inference

Hannah / Ben — technical notes for the export job and ops playbook: please share with MedicaSys once they pick delivery option.

Export playbook (high level)
- Job ID: audit-export-YYYYMMDD-<uuid> (we will supply the id in the manifest)
- Snapshot behavior: consistent cut at T0 using transaction journal to ensure event ordering; files sharded by month (2025-01.ndjson.gz -> 2025-12.ndjson.gz).
- Compression: gzip (level 6) and each shard accompanied by .sha256 file.
- Payload blobs: request/response payloads stored separately under objects/ with file pointer in the event row (not inlined unless requested).

Redaction specifics
- PII removal: email -> sha256(email + salt), phone -> last4 retained only, full names redacted to initials.
- If MedicaSys wants plaintext for a small subset we can create a scoped escrow package with additional NDA and access logging.

Delivery mechanics
- For S3 uploads we will:
  1) Assume the pre-authorized role you provide
  2) Upload to s3://redwood-audit-uploads/medicosys/2025_admin_activity/<job_id>/
  3) Provide a signed-manifest.csv and signed-manifest.csv.sig (rsa-sha256)
  4) Provide a delivery-log.jsonl (uploader, start_time, end_time, bytes_uploaded, parts)
- KMS: please provide the CMK arn; if you do not want CMK we will encrypt at rest using our KMS and provide an encrypted key blob (less preferred).

Verification notes
- Checksums: run sha256 on each downloaded shard and compare to manifest.
- We can also provide an audit-mode verification job that fetches objects and produces a verification report (hash match %, failed parts). This job takes ~2–4 hours for the estimated footprint.

Timeline and resource needs
- Once delivery method and role/CMK details are provided I can kick the snapshot job. Allow 48 hours for generation + upload.
- Ops will need a one-hour maintenance window to run the consistent cut.
